decision: When FullEnrich returns a syntactically valid work email without an email status, retain the email and write literal unknown to Twenty Person emailStatus.
rules: The literal value is lowercase unknown.
The absence of a provider status is preserved through status_source=a2_missing_provider_status_fallback.
unknown does not by itself satisfy verified named-email contactability or authorise outreach.
Email and emailStatus are written and reconciled together.
